stories.title: Israel votes at near-record pace in first election since Oct. 7 attacks
stories.summary: Israelis turned out at the fastest rate in nearly half a century on Tuesday in a vote widely seen as a referendum on the wartime leadership of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Turnout hit 74.3 percent by 8 p.m. local time, the highest since 1988, with the race between Netanyahu and former army chief Gadi Eisenkot too close to call.

stories.title: Houthis claim missile strike on largest Saudi oil refinery
stories.summary: The Iran-aligned Houthis in Yemen said they struck the Ras Tanura refinery, the largest in Saudi Arabia, with a ballistic missile, causing a fire at the complex. The attack escalates a conflict that has disrupted oil supplies and raised the risk of a wider regional war.

stories.title: Iraqi court sentences six French men to life in prison for IS membership
stories.summary: An Iraqi court sentenced six French nationals to life in prison and a seventh to 15 years after convicting them of Islamic State membership. The men were among 47 French IS suspects transferred from detention in northeast Syria to Iraq last year.

stories.title: Localized ceasefire takes effect in starving Ukrainian town of Oleshky
stories.summary: A localized ceasefire began Tuesday around Oleshky, a Russian-occupied Ukrainian town where residents face severe food and medicine shortages after four years of war. Brokered by US first lady Melania Trump with the involvement of Pope Leo, the truce aims to deliver aid and evacuate the roughly 2,000 people still there.

stories.title: OpenAI and Oracle expand partnership, bringing Oracle apps into ChatGPT
stories.summary: OpenAI and Oracle announced an expanded collaboration that brings Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and powers new Oracle products with OpenAI models. New offerings include Oracle AI Workspace, a security-testing service, and a small-business bundle, unveiled at Oracle AI World in Las Vegas.

stories.title: Anduril and Qualcomm unveil BlueChip, a US-built rugged laptop
stories.summary: Anduril and Qualcomm launched BlueChip, a hardened laptop designed and assembled in the US with roughly 90 percent of components sourced domestically or from allies. The Snapdragon-powered machine targets government and defense buyers, with circuit-board assembly planned at the Arsenal-1 plant in Ohio and orders opening in 2027.

stories.title: Israeli ad-tech firm heavily targeted Starlink users in apparent spying effort
stories.summary: Researchers found an Israeli ad-tech company, Discover-Tech, was the top bidder for ads shown to Starlink users in more than 100 countries, in what six sources described as an effort to geolocate and surveil them. Google and Comcast removed the company from their ad platforms after the findings were reported.

stories.title: Browns open Steelers week atop the AFC North
stories.summary: Cleveland began Week 8 preparations for a Sunday trip to Pittsburgh, where the franchise has not won a regular-season game since 2003. The Browns lead the AFC North after a last-second win over Tennessee, though the offense still ranks 26th in EPA per play.

stories.title: Ryan Day has not named a starting QB ahead of USC game
stories.summary: Ohio State coach Ryan Day said Tuesday he has not picked a starting quarterback for the Saturday game at USC, with Luke Fahey and Tavien St. Clair competing to replace the injured Julian Sayin. Day urged the team and fans to rally around whichever young quarterback gets the nod.

stories.title: FIA proposes simpler, cheaper V8 turbo hybrids for next F1 engine rules
stories.summary: The next Formula 1 engine regulations are set to introduce simplified 2.0-2.3-litre V8 turbo hybrid engines from 2030 or 2031, according to an FIA proposal sent to the six manufacturers. The plan aims to cut 80kg from car weight, boost emphasis on driver skill, and lower costs to attract new entrants.

stories.title: Bearman does not regret the US GP lunge that ended his race
stories.summary: Ollie Bearman said he does not regret the Turn 13 move that caused his United States GP collision with Pierre Gasly, despite a 10-second penalty and floor damage that forced his retirement. Gasly called the move a little optimistic but still salvaged P10 for Alpine.

stories.title: Williams confirms Browning for FP1 runs in Mexico and Brazil
stories.summary: Williams confirmed reserve driver Luke Browning will take over the car of Alex Albon in Mexico FP1 and that of Carlos Sainz in Brazil, completing the mandated rookie practice sessions. Browning has already driven the FW48 in Barcelona, Austria and Italy this season.

stories.title: Data centers become the flashpoint in final week of Ohio governor race
stories.summary: Data centers are the defining issue in the last week of the Ohio governor campaign: Democrat Amy Acton launched an ad attacking the stance of her opponent while a PAC backing Republican Vivek Ramaswamy fired back on the same topic. The exchange shows how data-center expansion has become a central economic and political fight in central Ohio.
